title: Why does the Moon change shape?
hook: Hello friends! Why is the Moon round some nights and a thin banana on others?
answer: The Moon is always a big round ball of rock. It does not make its own light. It only shines because the Sun lights it up, like a torch shining on a ball. As the Moon travels around the Earth, we see different amounts of its bright side. Sometimes all of it, sometimes a thin slice.
wowFact: Here is a wow fact! It takes about one whole month for the Moon to go from a thin slice to a full circle.
experiment: Try this! Look at the Moon tonight and draw its shape. Draw it again in a few nights. Did your Moon get bigger or smaller?
